notes.title: Starry Midnight 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

This Starry Midnight We Make has received a small update. 1.0.1 addresses the slowdown issues a few users have been reporting, as well as a few typographical errors found in the text. (SpaceDrake has been flogged accordingly for this oversight.) (ow)

We hope everyone continues to enjoy Starry Midnight!

notes.title: Fiddle With Fate In This Starry Midnight We Make s Demo
notes.notes:
Does the movement of the planets and stars influence your behaviour and your destiny? Other than making you giggle when astrologers talk about “Uranus rising”, I mean. Story-o-puzzler This Starry Midnight We Make [official site] gives the power to shape the sky and change the world.

Starry Midnight is the latest Japanese game being localised and published by Carpe Fulgur, the folks who brought Recettear: An Item Shop s Tale westward. They plan to release it later this month, but for now it has a demo you can try.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Store demo strangeness!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and thank you for your interest in Starry Midnight!

As always, it wouldn't be a launch without SOME kind of technical gremlin. For reasons we haven't been able to ascertain, the demo's store page is titled "untitled app demo" and isn't linked to the main store page quite right.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366820/

You can still find it at the link above, and the demo itself works just fine, so please try it out! We'll have the store entry sorted out as soon as we can.
